name: Windchime
summary: A proposal using a large array of precision mechanical sensors to detect correlated weak forces from passing ultraheavy dark matter, also investigating ultralight-field signals.
detection_principle: A passing particle leaves time-correlated impulse tracks in multiple sensors; ultralight fields may instead generate coherent periodic forces.

sites.name: Multi-institution US quantum-mechanical-sensing R&D; final large-array site undetermined

results.summary: The white paper discusses design and open R&D challenges; purely gravitational detection remains a long-term objective rather than a present capability.

science_scope: A mechanical-sensing project covering ultraheavy and ultralight dark matter. Its classification reflects quantum-sensing technology rather than an exclusive focus on axions; purely gravitational sensitivity must be distinguished from nearer-term achievable goals.
